summary: Pair with a computer to mirror a terminal session on e-ink. Needs your computer.
release_notes: The pairing address and code fields say what goes in them, a refused entry says why in place of the guidance, and a pairing that could not be saved offers Retry saving on its message.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already.
Pair this computer with the reader. There is nothing to type on the reader. The first time, close Cobalt and open it again afterwards.
Share a terminal and leave it open, then open Paperterm on the reader.

page_description: Mirror a terminal session from your computer onto e-ink. The shell, credentials, and scrollback stay on the computer; the Kobo renders the session over a paired connection.
